description: Grant a role to an account. Requires a service JWT (com.atproto.server.getServiceAuth) and the admin role. The change and its audit event are committed in one transaction.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The caller has no role or the role does not allow managing role bindings.

errors.name: RoleExists
errors.description: The subject already holds a role binding.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: The subject DID or role value is not acceptable.
